status: Initial implementation contract; example measurements are synthetic.
identity_rules: cell_uid persists across frames and compatible reruns through an explicit identity mapping; never regenerate identities from mask labels.
A biological division ends the parent track and starts new daughter tracks. Segmentation splits/merges are QC events until biological division is established.
lineage_code is scoped by experiment_uid and sequence_uid. L identifies the observed lineage; B is a unique branch number within the sequence. G00 means observed founder, not confirmed seeded.
Track fragments and unknown ancestry remain unresolved; do not invent parents.
On track merge/split corrections, retain an identity reconciliation log with superseded UID, replacement UID(s), reason and revision.
cross_row_validation: Parent and root UIDs must reference cells in the same experiment and sequence; roots reference themselves.
Parent graphs must be acyclic. Daughters have parent.generation + 1 and inherit the lineage root.
A confirmed parent must precede the daughter in time; inconsistent overlaps are flagged for review.
A root has generation 0 and null parent; daughter status requires a known parent.
CellProfiler object-to-mask mapping must be verified one-to-one before measurements are joined.
Feature keys must be registered in the feature dictionary; units and channel mappings must match the run.
Acquired_at is null exactly when acquisition_time_source is unknown.
Stable cell-level lineage fields agree across observations of the same cell within a lineage revision.
Hardware/software fields and their provenance agree for all cell observations of the same image in a run.
Each hardware/software field has provenance; a null value has source unknown. A populated value has a non-unknown source.
Embedded and sidecar metadata conflicts must be recorded in the image metadata output and flagged for review, never silently overwritten. User corrections retain original evidence.

outputs.image_metadata: image_metadata.jsonl (per-image normalized metadata, raw metadata reference, extraction status and conflicts; includes images with zero cells)

csv_rules: UTF-8, header row, comma delimiter and quoted fields as needed.
Scalar fields retain their names; features flatten to feature.<registered_key> columns.
qc_flags and tags are JSON-encoded cells.
Null scalar/feature values are empty CSV cells; zero is 0. Empty arrays/objects are []/{}.
Date and time are stored together in acquired_at to preserve offset; separate date/time display columns may be derived.
feature dictionaries may grow; unavailable features are null, and units are never inferred from names alone.
imaging_metadata_provenance is a JSON-encoded CSV cell. Hardware/software scalar fields are ordinary columns.
scope_notes: This schema reserves prediction fields; it does not implement a predictor.
Lineage requires time-series evidence or supplied annotations.
Full feature selection and channel-specific measurements will be finalized with sample images and a CellProfiler pipeline.
Per-image aggregate QC and run failures belong in image/run outputs, including images with zero detected cells.
Imaging metadata fields are placeholders for the future importer; extraction is not yet implemented. Availability depends on the exported image/sidecar contents.
Do not fill hardware/software fields from imaging_source or a default profile. User-supplied values must be explicitly attributed.
